title: Efficacy and Safety on Prouk for STEMI Patients in China
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of rh-prouk as pharmacoinvasive therapy on those ST Elevated Myocardial Infarctions patients, it is designed as a multicenter, active controlled, single blinded study. The primary endpoint is to assess the coronary recanalization 90 minutes after thrombolysis. The secondary endpoint is to evaluate the mortality rate at day 30.
